support.title: Can't find an answer?
support.text: Our support team is always ready to help you resolve any issues.

q1.question: What is Dormly?
q1.answer: Dormly is a platform designed to help students find the perfect roommate based on a personality and lifestyle compatibility test.

q2.question: How does the compatibility test work?
q2.answer: Our test analyzes your answers about habits, lifestyle, social activity, and personal preferences to find users with the highest compatibility percentage.

q3.question: Is Dormly free?
q3.answer: Yes, basic Dormly features (profile creation, taking the test, and finding roommates) are completely free for students.

q4.question: Can I change my test answers later?
q4.answer: Absolutely! You can retake the test or update your profile details in the settings at any time.
